output.scope: Examines evolving consumer behavior in the consumer products and retail ecosystem, including value, technology, trust, AI, and purchasing decisions. Based on a global survey of 12,000 consumers aged 18 and over across Australia, Canada, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands, Spain, Sweden, the UK, and the US, plus executive interviews; the survey was conducted in October 2025 and the report is dated 2026.
